bubbles.title: Rename in source
bubbles.hint: TRACK_DIR in src/lib/store.ts + every hard-coded .bubbles in src/lib (ops, links, model, render, io, cli/args, cli/bubbles) and the fog gate's isInsideBubblesDir; rebuild skills/bubble/scripts/. No fallback for the old name (we just dropped legacy compat).

bubbles.title: Move own tracks
bubbles.hint: git mv/mv .bubbles -> .bubble-tracks in this repo, .gitignore -> .bubble-tracks/current; check the plugin's hook still finds it

bubbles.title: Rename to bubble-tracks
bubbles.hint: Project name bubble-coding -> bubble-tracks: package.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json + marketplace.json, README, SKILL.md frontmatter, installer, site. Outward-facing (ask first): GitHub repo rename, Pages URL, installed plugin id bubble-coding@bubble-coding.
